JBrowseDesktopSessionModel.text:
# JBrowseDesktopSessionModel (Session model, core)

Holds a JBrowse Desktop session: its views, session tracks, assemblies, connections, theme and preferences, and the workspace layout.

Composes WorkspaceLayoutMixin, DesktopSessionTrackMenuMixin, TrackMenuItemsSessionMixin, AppSessionMixin, AssembliesMixin, PreferencesSessionMixin, BaseSessionModel, SnackbarModel, MultipleViewsSessionMixin, DrawerWidgetSessionMixin, SessionTracksManagerSessionMixin, TracksManagerSessionMixin, ReferenceManagementSessionMixin, ThemeManagerSessionMixin, ConnectionManagementSessionMixin — their members are listed below, nothing to follow.

## Actions
- `setActivePanelId(panelId: string | undefined) => void`
- `toggleMaximizedPanel(panelId: string) => void`: Show one cell at the size of the workspace, or go back; naming a different cell moves the mode. Unmounts every other cell's views rather than hiding them, to stay under the WebGL2 context ceiling (`agent-docs/reference/GPU_PORTABILITY.md`).
- `restorePanels() => void`
- `setActiveTab(panelId: string, tabId: string) => void`
- `renameTab(tabId: string, title: string | undefined) => void`
- `splitPanel(panelId: string, direction: "column" | "row", before?: any) => PanelNode | undefined`: Split a grid cell; the new cell gets one empty tab.
- `closePanel(panelId: string) => void`
- `addTab(panelId: string, viewIds?: string[]) => TabNode | undefined`: "New empty tab": a tab in an existing cell, showing the launcher.
- `closeTab(tabId: string) => void`: Close a tab, and its cell too if that was the last tab and not the workspace's last cell: a tabless cell renders nothing at all.
- `addViewToTab(tabId: string, viewId: string) => void`
- `dropTabInPanel(tabId: string, targetPanelId: string, index?: number | undefined) => void`: Drop a dragged tab into an existing panel, as a tab.
- `dropTabInNewSplit(tabId: string, targetPanelId: string, direction: "column" | "row", before: boolean) => string | undefined`: Drop a dragged tab on a panel edge: split, and put the tab in the new half.
- `setSizes(branchId: string, sizes: number[]) => void`
- `applyLayoutSpec(spec: LayoutSpecNode<LayoutViewRef>) => string[]`: Arrange the workspace as a spec states, in the shape a session spec's `layout` takes: a leaf's `views` names views by index into `session.views` or by id. A malformed leaf, an index past the end or an unknown id throws.
- `moveViewToNewTab(viewId: string) => string | undefined`: ViewMenu's "move to new tab": the view leaves its tab for a new one.
- `moveViewToSplit(viewId: string, direction: "column" | "row") => string | undefined`: ViewMenu's "move to split": the view moves to a new cell to the right (`row`) or below (`column`) of its current cell.
- `moveViewToTab(viewId: string, tabId: string) => void`: ViewMenu's "move to tab": the view joins an existing tab, which becomes the one shown.
- `homeUnassignedViews(viewIds: string[]) => void`
- `setPendingMove(move: PendingMove | undefined, _allViewIds?: string[] | undefined) => void`: Move one view to a new tab or a split beside its cell, keeping the rest of the arrangement. PUBLIC API: protein3d and msaview call it with the move alone. The second argument is an old plugin signature; the session's own views are read…
- `tileViews(mode: TileMode) => void`: Re-arrange the whole workspace, one view per cell, in one of four shapes, in `session.views` order.
- `layoutViews(spec: LayoutSpecNode<LayoutViewRef>) => string[]`: Arrange the session's views into panels: `applyLayoutSpec`, then `session.views` ordered to the spec's top-to-bottom order, which tabs read their order from. Leaves take view ids or indexes into `session.views`; a layout that seats no view…
- `renameCurrentSession(sessionName: string) => void`
- `addSessionAssembly(conf: AnyConfiguration) => BaseAssemblyConfig`
- `addAssembly(conf: AnyConfiguration) => void`
- `removeAssembly(name: string) => void`
- `removeSessionAssembly(assemblyName: string) => void`
- `addTemporaryAssembly(conf: AnyConfiguration) => BaseAssemblyConfig`: used for read vs ref type assemblies.
- `removeTemporaryAssembly(name: string) => void`
- `setSelection(thing: unknown) => void`: set the global selection, i.e. the globally-selected object. can be a feature, a view, or any other object
- `clearSelection() => void`: clears the global selection
- `setHovered(thing: unknown) => void`
- `setHighlightsVisible(arg: boolean) => void`
- `setHighlightLabelsVisible(arg: boolean) => void`
- `addHighlight(highlight: HighlightType) => void`: an identical entry is not added twice, so a spec launched again does not stack its bands. Adding shows the bands again, since a highlight made while they are off would otherwise read as nothing happening
- `removeHighlight(highlight: HighlightType) => void`
- `updateHighlight(old: HighlightType, updates: Partial<HighlightType>) => void`
- `setHighlights(highlights: HighlightType[]) => void`
- `setPreferenceOverride(key: string, value: unknown) => void`: set a runtime user-preference override (see `getPreference`). Mutates volatile state; products persist these to localStorage. An `undefined` value deletes the key, so the store holds no dead keys that `getPreference` would read as absent.
- `clearPreferenceOverrides() => void`: clear every runtime preference override at once, so each falls back to its config/admin default. Backs the Preferences dialog "Reset to defaults" button.
- `clearPreferenceOverride(key: string) => void`: clear a single runtime preference override (see `getPreference`) so it falls back to its config/admin default. Backs the per-entry reset in the Preferences dialog "Reset to defaults" confirmation.
- `setScrollZoom(flag: boolean) => void`: set the global scroll-to-zoom preference (see the `scrollZoom` getter)
- `setName(str: string) => void`
- `setFocusedViewId(viewId: string | undefined) => void`: `undefined` is "no view is focused", which the property can hold (`types.maybe`). `takeOut` sets it when the focused view leaves the session. Otherwise the dead id would match no view, since every consumer compares `focusedViewId ===…
- `removeActiveDialog() => void`: Dismiss the dialog on screen as the dialog's close button would, so a dialog that settles a promise on close (an internet account's token prompt) settles it, and drop it from the queue if it did not.
- `queueDialog<T extends DialogComponentType>(callback: (doneCallback: () => void) => [T, ComponentProps<T>]) => void`
- `removeDialog(entry: [DialogComponentType, Record<string, unknown>]) => void`
- `notify(message: string, level?: NotificationLevel | undefined, action?: SnackAction | SnackAction[] | undefined) => void`
- `notifyError(errorMessage: string, error?: unknown, extra?: unknown, action?: SnackAction | undefined) => void`
- `setErrorDialog(state: ErrorDialogState | undefined) => void`
- `pushSnackbarMessage(message: string, level?: NotificationLevel | undefined, actions?: SnackAction[] | undefined) => void`
- `popSnackbarMessage() => SnackbarMessage | undefined`
- `removeSnackbarMessage(message: string) => void`
- `moveViewDown(id: string, scopeIds?: string[] | undefined) => void`
- `moveViewUp(id: string, scopeIds?: string[] | undefined) => void`
- `moveViewToTop(id: string, scopeIds?: string[] | undefined) => void`
- `moveViewToBottom(id: string, scopeIds?: string[] | undefined) => void`
- `orderViews(ids: string[]) => void`: Put the named views into the given relative order, leaving unnamed views in their slots.
- `addView<N extends string>(typeName: N, initialState?: NoInfer<ViewSnapshotInput<N>> | undefined) => ViewModelOf<N>`: Requires the view type's state model to be loaded; for a lazily registered type use `launchView`.
- `replaceView<N extends string>(view: IBaseViewModel, typeName: N, initialState?: NoInfer<ViewSnapshotInput<N>> | undefined) => BaseViewModel & Pick<AbstractViewModel, "ass…`: swap `view` for a new view of `typeName`, in the slot it occupied.
- `removeView(view: IBaseViewModel) => void`
- `takeOutViewsMissingFrom(snapshot: unknown) => void`: Take out every view the given session snapshot will not keep, before a whole-tree `applySnapshot` destroys it where it stands.
- `setStickyViewHeaders(sticky: boolean) => void`
- `setUseWorkspaces(_useWorkspaces?: boolean | undefined) => void`: Does nothing: the workspace is always on. Kept because published protein3d and msaview bundles call it after placing a view.
- `launchView<N extends string>(typeName: N, initialState?: NoInfer<ViewSnapshotInput<N>> | undefined) => Promise<ViewModelOf<N>>`: `addView` for view types whose state model may be lazily loaded. The view is not in `session.views` until the promise resolves. `getViewType` first so an unknown type name fails by that name; the snapshot walk skips unregistered names and…
- `setDrawerPosition(arg: DrawerPosition) => void`
- `updateDrawerWidth(drawerWidth: number, availableWidth?: number) => number`
- `resizeDrawer(distance: number, availableWidth?: number) => number`
- `addWidget(typeName: string, id: string, initialState?: any, conf?: unknown) => Widget`
- `showWidget(widget: Widget) => void`
- `hideWidget(widget: Widget) => void`: closes the widget, and removes it from the session when its type sets `discardOnClose`. Minimizing the drawer is not closing.
- `minimizeWidgetDrawer() => void`
- `showWidgetDrawer() => void`
- `popoutWidget() => void`: show the visible widget in a modal dialog, freeing the drawer column
- `returnWidgetToDrawer() => void`
- `setModalWidgets(flag: boolean) => void`
- `hideAllWidgets() => void`
- `closeModalWidget() => void`: the modal's close button: a popped-out widget goes back to the drawer, and with no drawer to go back to the widget closes
- `openWidget(typeName: string, id: string, initialState?: any, conf?: unknown) => Widget`: adds the widget, replacing one with the same id, and shows it
- `editConfiguration(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel | { trackId: string; }, opts?: { expandedDisplayId?: string | undefined; } | undefined) => void`: opens a configuration editor to configure the given thing, and sets the current task to be configuring it
- `addSessionTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Add a track config to *this session*: it is added to `sessionTracks`, travels with the session when it is saved or shared, and never reaches the config.json the server hands every visitor.
- `publishTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Publish a track config to the shared catalog if this user can, and fall back to their session if they cannot: an admin's goes to `jbrowse.tracks`, which the admin server writes back into the config.json every visitor is served; everyone…
- `addTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Deprecated alias of `addSessionTrackConf`. Call that, or `publishTrackConf`.
- `updateTrackConfiguration(trackConf: PlainTrackConfig) => void`: Persist an edited track config as a delta (trackConfigDeltas) against its base, the sessionTracks or config.json entry — only the changed slots — so the edits persist, are shared, undo and reset, while changes to untouched fields of the…
- `promoteTrackConfigDeltas(trackId?: string | undefined) => void`: Write this session's track edits into the base configs — the config.json an admin server hands every visitor — and drop the deltas they were held in. One track's, or every track's when `trackId` is omitted, of `promotableTrackIds`: a…
- `resetTrackConfiguration(trackId: string) => void`: Drop a track's delta (trackConfigDeltas) so it reverts to its base, the sessionTracks or jbrowse.tracks entry. Unlike deleteTrackConf this does not dereference the track from open views — the base config re-resolves in place, so an open…
- `deleteTrackConf(trackConf: AnyTrackConfig) => PluggableConfigNode[] | undefined`
- `dereferenceTrack(trackId: string, referring: ReferringNode[]) => void`: Remove `trackId` from every view referring to it and close any config editor widget open on it. Runs immediately: the walk that produced `referring` has finished, so mutating those views here is safe.
- `setThemeName(name: string) => void`: Pick a palette. A name from before light and dark were an axis sets the mode it spelled as well, so an old share link, a saved figure spec and `jbrowse-img --theme darkStock` all still mean what they said. A palette pinned to one mode also…
- `noteDarkReader() => void`
- `setSystemPrefersDark(dark: boolean) => void`
- `setSystemThemeOverride(mode?: PaletteMode | undefined) => void`: Hold a session on the mode its setting is not asking for, or `undefined` to return to the setting. The toolbar's sun/moon writes this, so it stays in the toolbar after a click. The OS flipping clears it, since by then the OS has come round…
- `setThemeMode(mode: ThemeModeSelection) => void`: Draw the session light or dark, leaving the palette alone. `system` follows the OS preference. Satisfies `ThemeModeSession`, so `useSessionPalette` works against an app session and an embedded one alike, and a host that tracks dark mode…
- `makeConnection(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel, initialSnapshot?: object) => BaseConnectionModel`
- `breakConnection(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel) => void`: Remove a live connection instance. Tolerant of an already-dormant connection (its instance is stripped from the session on reload). Leaves persisted open-track configs alone — the connect() error path calls this and the user's already-open…
- `teardownConnection(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel) => void`: Close every track a connection contributed — the live instance's tracks plus any persisted open-track configs (a dormant connection, never expanded this session, still renders its opened tracks from `connectionTrackConfigs`) — from all…
- `deleteConnection(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel) => boolean`: Fully remove a connection: tear down its tracks and live instance, then delete its config.
- `addConnectionConf(connectionConf: AnyConfiguration) => BaseConnectionConfig`: Adds to the **config**, not the session: `jbrowse.connections`, which every visitor to this instance loads. jbrowse-web overrides this so a non-admin's connection goes to `sessionConnections` instead — see WebSessionConnectionsMixin, whose…
- `clearConnections() => void`
- `captureConnectionTrack(trackId: string) => void`: Snapshot a just-opened connection track's config into `connectionTrackConfigs` so it survives session reload. No-op if the track isn't connection-provided or is already captured (edits go through `updateConnectionTrackConfig`).
- `updateConnectionTrackConfig(trackConf: Record<string, unknown> & { trackId: string; }) => void`: Persist an edit to an opened connection track. The full config is stored (not a delta): the connection's fetched "base" isn't present at load, so only a complete config resolves synchronously.
- `setConnectionTrackConfig(trackId: string, connectionId: string, config: Record<string, unknown>) => void`: Upsert one opened connection track's persisted config.
- `pruneConnectionTrackConfig(trackId: string) => void`: Drop a connection track's persisted config once no open view still references it, so the session doesn't accumulate closed tracks.
- `hydrateConnection(connectionId: string) => void`: Lazily establish a single connection by id if it isn't already live; the track selector calls it when the connection's category is expanded. Fetches without launching a view or showing a success snackbar; already-open tracks keep rendering…

## Getters
- `tree: LayoutTree`: Referentially stable, since `getSnapshot` is cached. Uncast on purpose: this assignment is what checks the models above agree with the interfaces in `tree.ts`.
- `panels: PanelNode[]`
- `tabs: TabNode[]`
- `visibleTree: LayoutTree`: The maximized cell alone, or the whole tree. The cell is resized to 1 because CSS hands out free space by grow factor only up to a total of 1, so a third-of-a-row cell would draw a third of the window.
- `root: AppRootModel`

# JBrowseReactAppRootModel (Root model, core)

Holds the top-level state of the embeddable JBrowse React app: the loaded config, the session, internet accounts and the app menus.

Composes RootAppMenuMixin, InternetAccountsMixin, BaseRootModel — their members are listed below, nothing to follow.

## Actions
- `setPluginsUpdated() => void`
- `setPluginsUpdatedCallback(callback: (args: PluginsUpdate) => void) => void`
- `appendMenu(menuName: string) => void`: Add a top-level menu, if the app bar does not already have one with this name.
- `insertMenu(menuName: string, position: number) => void`: Insert a top-level menu, if the app bar does not already have one with this name.
- `appendToMenu(menuName: string, menuItem: MenuItem) => void`: Add a menu item to a top-level menu, creating the menu if it does not exist.
- `insertInMenu(menuName: string, menuItem: MenuItem, position: number) => void`: Insert a menu item into a top-level menu, creating the menu if it does not exist.
- `appendToSubMenu(menuPath: string[], menuItem: MenuItem) => void`: Add a menu item to a sub-menu, creating any part of the path that does not exist.
- `insertInSubMenu(menuPath: string[], menuItem: MenuItem, position: number) => void`: Insert a menu item into a sub-menu, creating any part of the path that does not exist.
- `initializeInternetAccount(internetAccountConfig: AnyConfigurationModel, initialSnapshot?: object) => any`
- `createEphemeralInternetAccount(internetAccountId: string, initialSnapshot: Record<string, unknown>, url: string) => any`
- `findAppropriateInternetAccount(location: UriLocation) => any`
- `setError(error: unknown) => void`
- `addDetachDisposer(disposer: () => void) => void`: Register something that must stop when the host detaches this root.
- `detach() => void`: Called when the host releases this root. Stops the worker pool and whatever was registered with `addDetachDisposer`, and leaves the tree itself alone.
- `setSession(sessionSnapshot?: any) => void`: Sets the active session. Remaps any legacy display type names (e.g. LinearPileupDisplay → LinearAlignmentsDisplay), drops nodes whose pluggable type this build has no plugin for (see `pruneUnbuildableNodes`), then walks the resulting MST…
- `setDefaultSession() => void`: Starts a new session from the config's defaultSession. An `id` in it (a pasted session export has one) is dropped, since sessions are autosaved by id and each new one would otherwise overwrite the last. The name has no date, because the…
- `setSessionPath(path: string) => void`
- `renameCurrentSession(newName: string) => void`

## Properties
- `internetAccounts = types.array( pluginManager.pluggableMstType('internet account', 'stateModel'), )`
- `jbrowse = jbrowseModelType`: `jbrowse` is a mapping of the config.json into the in-memory state tree
- `session = types.maybe(sessionModelType)`: `session` encompasses the currently active state of the app, including views open, tracks open in those views, etc.
- `sessionPath = types.stripDefault(types.string, '')`
- `assemblyManager = types.optional( assemblyManagerFactory(assemblyConfigSchema, pluginManager), {}, )`

## Methods
- `menus() => Menu[]`

# JBrowseReactCircularGenomeViewSessionModel (Session model, core)

The shared EmbeddedSessionMixin plus this product's tracks mixin and its single CircularView. Both are spelled out here rather than passed to a shared factory because `types.compose` cannot infer through a generic — see EmbeddedSessionMixin.

Composes SessionTracksManagerSessionMixin, TracksManagerSessionMixin, ReferenceManagementSessionMixin, BaseSessionModel, SnackbarModel, EmbeddedSessionMixin, EmbeddedSessionThemeMixin, TrackMenuSessionMixin, ConnectionManagementSessionMixin, DrawerWidgetSessionMixin — their members are listed below, nothing to follow.

## Actions
- `addView<N extends string>(typeName: N, initialState?: NoInfer<ViewSnapshotInput<N>> | undefined) => CircularView`: replaces view in this case
- `removeView() => void`: does nothing
- `launchView(typeName: string, initialState?: any) => Promise<CircularView>`: addView, async to satisfy the AbstractViewContainer contract
- `addSessionTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Add a track config to *this session*: it is added to `sessionTracks`, travels with the session when it is saved or shared, and never reaches the config.json the server hands every visitor.
- `publishTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Publish a track config to the shared catalog if this user can, and fall back to their session if they cannot: an admin's goes to `jbrowse.tracks`, which the admin server writes back into the config.json every visitor is served; everyone…
- `addTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Deprecated alias of `addSessionTrackConf`. Call that, or `publishTrackConf`.
- `updateTrackConfiguration(trackConf: PlainTrackConfig) => void`: Persist an edited track config as a delta (trackConfigDeltas) against its base, the sessionTracks or config.json entry — only the changed slots — so the edits persist, are shared, undo and reset, while changes to untouched fields of the…
- `promoteTrackConfigDeltas(trackId?: string | undefined) => void`: Write this session's track edits into the base configs — the config.json an admin server hands every visitor — and drop the deltas they were held in. One track's, or every track's when `trackId` is omitted, of `promotableTrackIds`: a…
- `resetTrackConfiguration(trackId: string) => void`: Drop a track's delta (trackConfigDeltas) so it reverts to its base, the sessionTracks or jbrowse.tracks entry. Unlike deleteTrackConf this does not dereference the track from open views — the base config re-resolves in place, so an open…
- `deleteTrackConf(trackConf: AnyTrackConfig) => PluggableConfigNode[] | undefined`
- `dereferenceTrack(trackId: string, referring: ReferringNode[]) => void`: Remove `trackId` from every view referring to it and close any config editor widget open on it. Runs immediately: the walk that produced `referring` has finished, so mutating those views here is safe.
- `setSelection(thing: unknown) => void`: set the global selection, i.e. the globally-selected object. can be a feature, a view, or any other object
- `clearSelection() => void`: clears the global selection
- `setHovered(thing: unknown) => void`
- `setHighlightsVisible(arg: boolean) => void`
- `setHighlightLabelsVisible(arg: boolean) => void`
- `addHighlight(highlight: HighlightType) => void`: an identical entry is not added twice, so a spec launched again does not stack its bands. Adding shows the bands again, since a highlight made while they are off would otherwise read as nothing happening
- `removeHighlight(highlight: HighlightType) => void`
- `updateHighlight(old: HighlightType, updates: Partial<HighlightType>) => void`
- `setHighlights(highlights: HighlightType[]) => void`
- `setPreferenceOverride(key: string, value: unknown) => void`: set a runtime user-preference override (see `getPreference`). Mutates volatile state; products persist these to localStorage. An `undefined` value deletes the key, so the store holds no dead keys that `getPreference` would read as absent.
- `clearPreferenceOverrides() => void`: clear every runtime preference override at once, so each falls back to its config/admin default. Backs the Preferences dialog "Reset to defaults" button.
- `clearPreferenceOverride(key: string) => void`: clear a single runtime preference override (see `getPreference`) so it falls back to its config/admin default. Backs the per-entry reset in the Preferences dialog "Reset to defaults" confirmation.
- `setScrollZoom(flag: boolean) => void`: set the global scroll-to-zoom preference (see the `scrollZoom` getter)
- `setName(str: string) => void`
- `setFocusedViewId(viewId: string | undefined) => void`: `undefined` is "no view is focused", which the property can hold (`types.maybe`). `takeOut` sets it when the focused view leaves the session. Otherwise the dead id would match no view, since every consumer compares `focusedViewId ===…
- `removeActiveDialog() => void`: Dismiss the dialog on screen as the dialog's close button would, so a dialog that settles a promise on close (an internet account's token prompt) settles it, and drop it from the queue if it did not.
- `queueDialog<T extends DialogComponentType>(callback: (doneCallback: () => void) => [T, ComponentProps<T>]) => void`
- `removeDialog(entry: [DialogComponentType, Record<string, unknown>]) => void`
- `notify(message: string, level?: NotificationLevel | undefined, action?: SnackAction | SnackAction[] | undefined) => void`
- `notifyError(errorMessage: string, error?: unknown, extra?: unknown, action?: SnackAction | undefined) => void`
- `setErrorDialog(state: ErrorDialogState | undefined) => void`
- `pushSnackbarMessage(message: string, level?: NotificationLevel | undefined, actions?: SnackAction[] | undefined) => void`
- `popSnackbarMessage() => SnackbarMessage | undefined`
- `removeSnackbarMessage(message: string) => void`
- `setThemeMode(mode: PaletteMode) => void`: Switch the session to light or dark, leaving the host's configured colors alone. The renderer receives the mode in `themeOptions`, so labels drawn in the worker follow it, and `palette` is derived from the same args, so React-drawn…
- `makeConnection(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel, initialSnapshot?: object) => BaseConnectionModel`
- `breakConnection(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel) => void`: Remove a live connection instance. Tolerant of an already-dormant connection (its instance is stripped from the session on reload). Leaves persisted open-track configs alone — the connect() error path calls this and the user's already-open…
- `teardownConnection(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel) => void`: Close every track a connection contributed — the live instance's tracks plus any persisted open-track configs (a dormant connection, never expanded this session, still renders its opened tracks from `connectionTrackConfigs`) — from all…
- `deleteConnection(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel) => boolean`: Fully remove a connection: tear down its tracks and live instance, then delete its config.
- `addConnectionConf(connectionConf: AnyConfiguration) => BaseConnectionConfig`: Adds to the **config**, not the session: `jbrowse.connections`, which every visitor to this instance loads. jbrowse-web overrides this so a non-admin's connection goes to `sessionConnections` instead — see WebSessionConnectionsMixin, whose…
- `clearConnections() => void`
- `captureConnectionTrack(trackId: string) => void`: Snapshot a just-opened connection track's config into `connectionTrackConfigs` so it survives session reload. No-op if the track isn't connection-provided or is already captured (edits go through `updateConnectionTrackConfig`).
- `updateConnectionTrackConfig(trackConf: Record<string, unknown> & { trackId: string; }) => void`: Persist an edit to an opened connection track. The full config is stored (not a delta): the connection's fetched "base" isn't present at load, so only a complete config resolves synchronously.
- `setConnectionTrackConfig(trackId: string, connectionId: string, config: Record<string, unknown>) => void`: Upsert one opened connection track's persisted config.
- `pruneConnectionTrackConfig(trackId: string) => void`: Drop a connection track's persisted config once no open view still references it, so the session doesn't accumulate closed tracks.
- `hydrateConnection(connectionId: string) => void`: Lazily establish a single connection by id if it isn't already live; the track selector calls it when the connection's category is expanded. Fetches without launching a view or showing a success snackbar; already-open tracks keep rendering…
- `setDrawerPosition(arg: DrawerPosition) => void`
- `updateDrawerWidth(drawerWidth: number, availableWidth?: number) => number`
- `resizeDrawer(distance: number, availableWidth?: number) => number`
- `addWidget(typeName: string, id: string, initialState?: any, conf?: unknown) => Widget`
- `showWidget(widget: Widget) => void`
- `hideWidget(widget: Widget) => void`: closes the widget, and removes it from the session when its type sets `discardOnClose`. Minimizing the drawer is not closing.
- `minimizeWidgetDrawer() => void`
- `showWidgetDrawer() => void`
- `popoutWidget() => void`: show the visible widget in a modal dialog, freeing the drawer column
- `returnWidgetToDrawer() => void`
- `setModalWidgets(flag: boolean) => void`
- `hideAllWidgets() => void`
- `closeModalWidget() => void`: the modal's close button: a popped-out widget goes back to the drawer, and with no drawer to go back to the widget closes
- `openWidget(typeName: string, id: string, initialState?: any, conf?: unknown) => Widget`: adds the widget, replacing one with the same id, and shows it
- `editConfiguration(configuration: AnyConfigurationModel | { trackId: string; }, opts?: { expandedDisplayId?: string | undefined; } | undefined) => void`: opens a configuration editor to configure the given thing, and sets the current task to be configuring it

# JBrowseReactLinearGenomeViewSessionModel (Session model, core)

The shared EmbeddedSessionMixin plus this product's tracks mixin, its single LinearGenomeView, and `disableAddTracks`, which is a root prop rather than a session one. The mixin and the view are spelled out here rather than passed to a shared factory because `types.compose` cannot infer through a generic — see EmbeddedSessionMixin.

Composes SessionTracksManagerSessionMixin, TracksManagerSessionMixin, ReferenceManagementSessionMixin, BaseSessionModel, SnackbarModel, EmbeddedSessionMixin, EmbeddedSessionThemeMixin, TrackMenuSessionMixin, ConnectionManagementSessionMixin, DrawerWidgetSessionMixin — their members are listed below, nothing to follow.

- `addView<N extends string>(typeName: N, initialState?: NoInfer<ViewSnapshotInput<N>> | undefined) => LinearGenomeView`
- `removeView() => void`
- `launchView(typeName: string, initialState?: any) => Promise<LinearGenomeView>`: same as addView — the single view type here is always eagerly registered, so there is nothing to load; async to satisfy the AbstractViewContainer contract
- `addSessionTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Add a track config to *this session*: it is added to `sessionTracks`, travels with the session when it is saved or shared, and never reaches the config.json the server hands every visitor.
- `publishTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Publish a track config to the shared catalog if this user can, and fall back to their session if they cannot: an admin's goes to `jbrowse.tracks`, which the admin server writes back into the config.json every visitor is served; everyone…
- `addTrackConf(trackConf: AnyConfiguration) => AnyTrackConfig | undefined`: Deprecated alias of `addSessionTrackConf`. Call that, or `publishTrackConf`.
- `updateTrackConfiguration(trackConf: PlainTrackConfig) => void`: Persist an edited track config as a delta (trackConfigDeltas) against its base, the sessionTracks or config.json entry — only the changed slots — so the edits persist, are shared, undo and reset, while changes to untouched fields of the…
- `promoteTrackConfigDeltas(trackId?: string | undefined) => void`: Write this session's track edits into the base configs — the config.json an admin server hands every visitor — and drop the deltas they were held in. One track's, or every track's when `trackId` is omitted, of `promotableTrackIds`: a…
- `resetTrackConfiguration(trackId: string) => void`: Drop a track's delta (trackConfigDeltas) so it reverts to its base, the sessionTracks or jbrowse.tracks entry. Unlike deleteTrackConf this does not dereference the track from open views — the base config re-resolves in place, so an open…
- `deleteTrackConf(trackConf: AnyTrackConfig) => PluggableConfigNode[] | undefined`
- `dereferenceTrack(trackId: string, referring: ReferringNode[]) => void`: Remove `trackId` from every view referring to it and close any config editor widget open on it. Runs immediately: the walk that produced `referring` has finished, so mutating those views here is safe.
- `setSelection(thing: unknown) => void`: set the global selection, i.e. the globally-selected object. can be a feature, a view, or any other object
- `clearSelection() => void`: clears the global selection
- `setHovered(thing: unknown) => void`
- `setHighlightsVisible(arg: boolean) => void`
- `setHighlightLabelsVisible(arg: boolean) => void`
- `addHighlight(highlight: HighlightType) => void`: an identical entry is not added twice, so a spec launched again does not stack its bands. Adding shows the bands again, since a highlight made while they are off would otherwise read as nothing happening
- `removeHighlight(highlight: HighlightType) => void`
- `updateHighlight(old: HighlightType, updates: Partial<HighlightType>) => void`
- `setHighlights(highlights: HighlightType[]) => void`
- `setPreferenceOverride(key: string, value: unknown) => void`: set a runtime user-preference override (see `getPreference`). Mutates volatile state; products persist these to localStorage. An `undefined` value deletes the key, so the store holds no dead keys that `getPreference` would read as absent.
- `clearPreferenceOverrides() => void`: clear every runtime preference override at once, so each falls back to its config/admin default. Backs the Preferences dialog "Reset to defaults" button.
- `clearPreferenceOverride(key: string) => void`: clear a single runtime preference override (see `getPreference`) so it falls back to its config/admin default. Backs the per-entry reset in the Preferences dialog "Reset to defaults" confirmation.

- `setName(str: string) => void`

# JBrowseWebRootModel (Root model, core)

Holds JBrowse Web's top-level state: the loaded config, the session, internet accounts, undo history, the app menus and the saved sessions kept in the browser.

Composes RootAppMenuMixin, HistoryManagementMixin, InternetAccountsMixin, BaseRootModel — their members are listed below, nothing to follow.

## Actions
- `setSavedSessionMetadata(sessions: SessionMetadata[]) => void`
- `fetchSessionMetadata() => Promise<void>`: Re-reads the whole `metadata` store. For anything that changes rows this model didn't just write itself (first load, pruning, favorite, rename, delete) — the autosave path uses `upsertSessionMetadata` instead.
- `upsertSessionMetadata(meta: SessionMetadata) => void`: Merges a row this model has just written into the in-memory list. The autosave autorun writes exactly one row on every throttled session edit — every 400ms for as long as you keep panning — and already holds its contents, so re-reading…
- `setSessionDB(sessionDB: SessionDBHandle | undefined) => void`
- `setPluginsUpdated() => void`
- `setReloadPluginManagerCallback(callback: (configSnapshot: Record<string, unknown>, sessionSnapshot: Record<string, unknown>) => void) => void`
- `activateSession(id: string) => Promise<void>`
- `openSessionCopy(snap: Record<string, unknown>) => Promise<void>`: Opens a session snapshot under a fresh id, so it autosaves beside the session it came from rather than over it.
- `setSavedSessionFavorite(id: string, favorite: boolean) => Promise<void>`
- `deleteSavedSession(id: string) => Promise<void>`
- `deleteSavedSessions(ids: string[]) => Promise<number>`: Deletes a batch of saved sessions in ONE transaction, and re-reads the metadata once at the end. Looping `deleteSavedSession` instead is both N transactions and N full `getAll('metadata')` scans, and — because those interleave — leaves…
- `renameSavedSession(id: string, name: string) => Promise<void>`
- `appendMenu(menuName: string) => void`: Add a top-level menu, if the app bar does not already have one with this name.
- `insertMenu(menuName: string, position: number) => void`: Insert a top-level menu, if the app bar does not already have one with this name.
- `appendToMenu(menuName: string, menuItem: MenuItem) => void`: Add a menu item to a top-level menu, creating the menu if it does not exist.
- `insertInMenu(menuName: string, menuItem: MenuItem, position: number) => void`: Insert a menu item into a top-level menu, creating the menu if it does not exist.
- `appendToSubMenu(menuPath: string[], menuItem: MenuItem) => void`: Add a menu item to a sub-menu, creating any part of the path that does not exist.
- `insertInSubMenu(menuPath: string[], menuItem: MenuItem, position: number) => void`: Insert a menu item into a sub-menu, creating any part of the path that does not exist.
- `initializeInternetAccount(internetAccountConfig: AnyConfigurationModel, initialSnapshot?: object) => any`
- `createEphemeralInternetAccount(internetAccountId: string, initialSnapshot: Record<string, unknown>, url: string) => any`
- `findAppropriateInternetAccount(location: UriLocation) => any`
- `setError(error: unknown) => void`
- `addDetachDisposer(disposer: () => void) => void`: Register something that must stop when the host detaches this root.
- `detach() => void`: Called when the host releases this root. Stops the worker pool and whatever was registered with `addDetachDisposer`, and leaves the tree itself alone.
- `setSession(sessionSnapshot?: any) => void`: Sets the active session. Remaps any legacy display type names (e.g. LinearPileupDisplay → LinearAlignmentsDisplay), drops nodes whose pluggable type this build has no plugin for (see `pruneUnbuildableNodes`), then walks the resulting MST…
- `setDefaultSession() => void`: Starts a new session from the config's defaultSession. An `id` in it (a pasted session export has one) is dropped, since sessions are autosaved by id and each new one would otherwise overwrite the last. The name has no date, because the…
- `setSessionPath(path: string) => void`
- `renameCurrentSession(newName: string) => void`

## Properties
- `configPath = types.maybe(types.string)`
- `history = types.optional(TimeTraveller, { targetPath: '../session' })`: used for undo/redo
- `internetAccounts = types.array( pluginManager.pluggableMstType('internet account', 'stateModel'), )`
- `jbrowse = jbrowseModelType`: `jbrowse` is a mapping of the config.json into the in-memory state tree
- `session = types.maybe(sessionModelType)`: `session` encompasses the currently active state of the app, including views open, tracks open in those views, etc.
- `sessionPath = types.stripDefault(types.string, '')`
- `assemblyManager = types.optional( assemblyManagerFactory(assemblyConfigSchema, pluginManager), {}, )`

## Methods
- `menus() => Menu[]`

# JBrowseWebSessionModel (Session model, core)

The full-app web session: the shared web session plus the saved-session database management surface (favorites, recent sessions, activate/delete) and the permanent plugin list.

Composes WebSessionManagementMixin, BaseWebSessionModel, TrackMenuItemsSessionMixin, WorkspaceLayoutMixin, WebSessionConnectionsMixin, ConnectionManagementSessionMixin, AppSessionMixin, AssembliesMixin, SessionTracksManagerSessionMixin, TracksManagerSessionMixin, ReferenceManagementSessionMixin, BaseSessionModel, SnackbarModel, PreferencesSessionMixin, MultipleViewsSessionMixin, DrawerWidgetSessionMixin, ThemeManagerSessionMixin — their members are listed below, nothing to follow.

# KeyedFetchMixin (Mixin model, core)

`FetchMixin` plus the one freshness compare a single-payload fetch runs: the key of what the view, settings and adapter call for (`currentFetchKey`) against the key the held data was committed under (`loadedFetchKey`). The LGV global family composes it under `GlobalFetchMixin` and the comparative family under `ComparativeFetchMixin`; the per-region family answers the same question per region through `isCacheValid`, so it stays on `FetchMixin` (ADR-105).

Composes FetchMixin — their members are listed below, nothing to follow.

- `setError(error?: unknown) => void`
- `setStatusMessage(status?: RpcStatus | undefined) => void`: Unthrottled: a display writing a phase label by hand must see every write land. The high-frequency RPC stream is thinned one level up, by the streams `self.statusWindow` hands out — and aggregated across them, which a write by hand is not.
- `stopActiveFetch() => void`: Abort the in-flight fetch (if any) and retire its slot. The shared preamble of both cancel paths; the difference between them is only what they do to `fetchCanceled` / `fetchGeneration` afterward.

- `cancelFetch() => void`: cancel any in-flight fetch and bump fetchGeneration (always bumps, so callers can retrigger fetch autoruns even when nothing was in flight). This is the *internal* reset `clearAllRpcData` runs — it clears any user-cancel flag so the…
- `cancelFetchByUser() => void`: User-initiated cancel from the loading overlay. Stops the in-flight fetch and sets the durable `fetchCanceled` state. Unlike `cancelFetch`, it does not bump fetchGeneration, so the fetch autoruns do not immediately restart the load. The…
- `beforeDestroy() => void`: Abort an in-flight fetch on teardown. Without this, a display destroyed mid-fetch (track/view closed while loading) never signals the worker to abort the now-useless work, and its in-flight HTTP reads keep downloading. MST auto-chains…

- `endFetch(current: boolean) => void`: The `finally` half of `runFetch`'s bookkeeping, a separate action because `runFetchOnce`'s `finally` resumes on a microtask the flow does not own — a direct volatile write there is outside the action context, which is the one thing…

- `dataSuperseded: boolean`: Overridable hook (default false): the held data matches the key, but the screen will settle on different data — a dependent fetch is still out, or a fetch input the display writes itself has moved. The same hook `MultiRegionDisplayMixin`…
- `currentFetchKey: FetchKey | undefined`: Key of the fetch the current view, settings and adapter call for. The fetch skeleton's freshness key: captured at issue, compared against the stamp above, and written to it at commit. Its identity survives a recomputation onto equal…
- `dataCurrent: boolean`: The shared freshness answer every foundation gives: data has been committed (`loadedFetchKey` is only ever written beside it), it was fetched for the current view and settings, and the display is not about to supersede it itself. A pan…
- `isLoading: boolean`: true while a fetch is active
- `isLoadingOrCanceled: boolean`: `isLoading` widened to cover a user-canceled load: what a hover gate wants, since neither state has a frame on screen that a hit describes. Not a phase input — `computeActivityPhase` reads the two apart, because a cancel is finished…

Config slots: docs topic "config:LDTrackDisplay" (or jb.describeSlots(node.configuration) live).

The painted field's own scheme writes `scheme` unset, so it keeps following the field.

## Getters
- `view: LinearGenomeView`
- `prefersOffset: boolean`
- `lineZoneHeight: number`
- `colorField: LDMetric`: `encoding.color.field`, the statistic the fetch asks the file for.
- `showGuides: boolean`
- `showNames: boolean`
- `tickHeight: number`
- `variantLayout: "columns" | "genomic"`
- `snps: LDSnp[]`: The loaded SNPs in screen order along the column axis.
- `cellWidth: number`: The column width the payload was laid out at.
- `viewSignature: string | undefined`: The dynamic blocks: the SNP set is the viewport's, so a pan refetches while the stale triangle draws under the live transform.
- `atGenomicPositions: boolean`: Whether the loaded matrix is at genomic positions: a multi-region view falls back to uniform columns.
- `r2Available: boolean`
- `dprimeAvailable: boolean`
- `focalSnpIndex: number`: Index of the focal SNP in `snps`, or -1.
- `paintedColorField: LDMetric`: The loaded metric, so a stale triangle during a metric switch keeps its hue.
- `colorExtent: readonly [number, number]`: What an open end of the color domain follows: the statistic's own 0 to 1, not the loaded values, so one r² paints one color on every track.
- `colorScales: ColorScale[]`: The ramp the cells paint through, titled by the loaded metric. An end pinned inside the statistic's 0 to 1 reads `≤` or `≥`.
- `renderState: LDRenderState`
- `matrixTop: number`: The band above the matrix: the connector lines in columns, the labels at genomic positions when they are on, else nothing.
- `connectorLineCoords: ConnectorCoord[]`: Each column tied to its SNP's genomic x, for the connector lines.
- `heightMode: "fit" | "fixed"`
- `canvasWidth: number`: The canvas spans the scrolled content, boundary padding included.
- `viewTransform: { viewScale: number; viewOffsetX: number; }`
- `matrixRegions: ReadonlyMap<number, D>`: The one payload under key 0, absent until the fetch lands. An empty matrix keeps the key: the cleared canvas is its picture.
- `matrixHeight: number`
- `matrixBlocks: RenderBlock[]`
- `yScalar: number`: The squash takes the content's base, without the boundary padding a scroll past either end adds.
- `triangleTransform: { yScalar: number; yOffsetPx: number; viewScale: number; viewOffsetX: number; }`
- `triangleFrame: TriangleFrame`
- `writtenColor: ColorSlots`: The `encoding.color` channel as these writes and an Apply button read it, `writtenColorOf`.
- `parkedColor: ColorSlots | undefined`: The `color` object's parked field
- `colorEncoding: MatrixColorEncoding<F>`: The color channel under the painted field's preset, with an unset `scale.reverse` turning round a scheme dark at its low end, since an unpainted cell is the page behind the matrix. The preset's scheme, and its direction with it, fill…
- `colorScaleType: "linear" | "log" | "symlog"`
- `colorScheme: "blues" | "cividis" | "fall" | "inferno" | "juicebox" | "magma" | "purpleorange" | "redblue" | "redgreyblue" | "reds" | "redyellowblue" | "viridis"`
- `colorReverse: boolean`: `scale.reverse`, or where unset whether the scheme runs dark at its low end.
- `colorRamp: Uint8Array<ArrayBufferLike>`: The ramp's 256 entries: the GPU's texture, the Canvas2D fill and the legend read this one table. It reads `colorScheme` and `colorReverse` rather than the encoding, so a domain edit re-uploads no texture.

- `colorDomain: [number, number]`
- `colorMidNorm: number`: Where `domainMid` sits on the normalized ramp, 0.5 unset, so a diverging scheme centres on it and equal distances from it take equal colors.
- `matrixColor: MatrixColorState`
- `colorFieldTitle: string`: The painted field's own key title, from its preset.
- `showLegend: boolean`: Whether the legend is drawn.

- `legendTop: number`: Overridable hook (default 0): px the on-screen key is pushed down from the key's inset, for a display whose top rows hold the data a reader reads the rest against — the multi-way anchor lane. Not read by the export.

- `hasLegendKey: boolean`: Whether the display has a key at all. The "Legend" row is offered only when it does. Overridable for a display whose key is only waiting for data: a scale that stays empty until a region lands must not remove the toggle in the meantime.
- `host: RegionHost`: The hosting view as the `RegionHost` contract — see `containingHost` for the cast it owns, why the name is `host` and not `view`, and why both foundations still declare the name over one body.
- `canvasWidthPx: number`: The CSS width of this display's on-screen canvas, in px; see `trackCanvasWidthPx`. A heatmap laid out over the whole content reads the content width instead (`TriangleMatrixMixin.canvasWidth`).

- `dynamicBlockSignature: string | undefined`: The same over `dynamicBlocks`, for a display whose fetch window is the live viewport rather than the snapped block set (LD).
- `viewportEmpty: boolean`: No content block is on screen, so this display has nothing to fetch and nothing to paint — see `viewportEmpty.ts` for the one viewport that reaches it, how narrow that is, and why the state still has to be terminal rather than a permanent…
- `canRender: boolean`: Overrides `RenderLifecycleMixin`'s default-true hook with the LGV precondition both foundations share — see `foundationCanRender`.
- `rendersCanvas: boolean`: Fills `RenderLifecycleMixin`'s hook off `fetchInert`: a display that will never fetch here shows a placeholder where its canvas would be, so `painted` and the pre-first-paint scrim term stop waiting on a paint that cannot come. This is…

- `svgReady: boolean`: Policy single-sourced in `computeSvgReady`; this family supplies only the freshness half, which `foundationSvgReady` reads as `dataCurrent` or the vacuous currency of `viewportEmpty`. Note it requires the dataset to actually be current,…
- `displayPhase: DisplayPhase`: The display's mutually-exclusive visual state, mapped in `foundationDisplayPhase` — every foundation calls it and supplies only its staleness argument, so a term added to `computeActivityPhase` reaches all of them without being wired twice.

- `isLoading: boolean`: true while a fetch is active

- `fetchInert: boolean`: Overridable hook (default false): the states where this display deliberately skips fetching, so its data stays empty. Sequence sets it past base resolution ("Zoom in to see sequence"); LD sets it with the triangle toggled off.
- `awaitingPrerequisite: boolean`: Overridable hook (default false), read only by the retry contract check (`makeRetryContractCheck`): "this run declined because a prerequisite fetch in another autorun has not landed, and its arrival wakes this one again". It **defers** the…
- `awaitingDependentData: boolean`: Overridable hook (default false), read by `computeActivityPhase` and `foundationSvgReady`: a load this display depends on beyond its primary fetch has not landed for the first time, so the frame the primary fetch calls current is still…
- `settingsFetchInputs: unknown`: The settings axis every fetch family invalidates on: this display's `rpcProps()` payload and its adapter config, as one value compared structurally. The per-region family watches it from `SettingsInvalidate` and stamps it on each region,…
- `paintSuperseded: boolean`: Overridable hook (default false): what is on the canvas was painted from data a later change has made wrong, so `painted` below should answer *pending* until the repaint lands even though `canvasDrawn` is still true. The per-region fetch…
- `painted: boolean`: **The first-paint answer every consumer outside the display should read**, `canvasDrawn` being only the raw flag: a display that is deliberately not painting a canvas has finished, and reporting it unfinished leaves every waiter on it…
- `gateEnabled: boolean`: The opt-in. Overridden with a literal `true` by gated displays, and `check-gated-adapter-budgets` insists on a literal: this mixin returns early on it in an autorun and in `commitFetchBytes`.
- `byteGateAdapterConfig: Record<string, unknown>`: The adapter config the gate measures — the one at `byteGateAdapterPath`. Overridable for a display whose adapter config is synthesized rather than read off the track.

- `adapterFetchSizeLimit: number | undefined`: The measured adapter's own `fetchSizeLimit` slot, read off the live track config rather than the `adapterConfig` snapshot, which omits slots at their default.

- `gateViewport: GateViewport | undefined`: What a measurement taken now would be about: the span on screen, and a key for the stretch of genome it covers **and the settings it would be taken under**. Undefined until the view is measured, and with gateViewportSpanBp the mixin's only…
- `aboveForceLoadFloor: boolean`: Whether the span on screen is at or above `AUTO_FORCE_LOAD_BP`, the one comparison against that constant. False on an unmeasured view.
- `gateExempt: boolean`: Nothing may gate on either axis: the `forceLoad` slot or the button.
- `estimatedFetchBytes: number | undefined`: The stored estimate's bytes; undefined when nothing has been measured.
- `gateMeasurementStale: boolean`: Whether the last measurement still describes what a fetch issued now would ask: the viewport on screen, under the settings on screen. True before any measurement. The triple's third term, the adapter tier, is not here — a tier swap drops…

- `allottedHeight: number`: The height the display lays itself out in: its host's where one sets it, else the slot's.
- `height: number`

- `scrollViewportHeight: number`: Overridable hook: the height of the window it scrolls behind, in px.

- `parentTrack: AbstractTrackModel`
- `RenderingComponent: React.FC<{ model: typeof self; onHorizontalScroll?: (distance: number) => void; blockState?: Record<string, unknown>; }>`
- `DisplayBlurb: React.FC<{ model: typeof self; }> | null`
- `adapterConfig: Record<string, unknown>`
- `isMinimized: boolean`: Returns true if the parent track is minimized. Used to skip expensive operations like autoruns when track is not visible.
- `hoveredFeature: unknown`: Overridable hook (default `undefined`): what the pointer is currently over, for readers **outside** the display. `LinearGenomeViewContainer` publishes it to `session.hovered`, the view-wide "what is the user pointing at" channel a plugin…
